rules: Every 'checks' id must appear exactly once with required=yes and a verdict in PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN; a required check is satisfied only by PASS. 'groups' members must be contiguous 1..n with n >= min, each required=yes. 'advisory' ids may appear at most once with required=no; only advisory ids with allow_info may be INFO. Any other id is rejected. Changing this file changes its sha256, which is recorded in results.json and must match the copy at the tested commit. v1.1.0/2.0.0: group members are DERIVED from the tested commit's tree (HASH-i must name the i-th sorted tracked evidence/**/SHA256SUMS path; ENTRA-04.i the i-th sorted evidence/entra/runs/<run> directory), so adding or dropping a member cannot hide behind 'min'. Every tracked file at the tested commit must fall under a scope.modules path (with registered checks) or a scope.non_module_paths entry; every module path must exist. Source data that cannot be read from git at the tested commit makes the result INVALID (fail closed). v2.0.0: the verifier requires --sha (no unbound mode); execution_state and SUMMARY.md are recomputed; postgres-run/** is covered by the top-level SHA256SUMS; review records must name the contract requirement_ids they cover; the gate never reports ACCEPTED.

provenance.note: Provenance fields are recorded and type-checked and exported as a github-actions-run anchor; they are NOT authenticated (no GitHub API call is made by the gate).

review_scope.note: Each --reviews record must carry requirement_ids: a non-empty list of contract requirement ids present in the exported document. It is attached ONLY to those requirements. A record without requirement_ids, with a blanket/unknown id, or whose reviewer is the recorder/integrator makes the decision INVALID. Reviews are unauthenticated claims: the gate never reports ACCEPTED (at most REVIEW_CONCURRED_UNAUTHENTICATED).
